## What's new in 0.29.3

Fixes HRTF for headphone users, and adds new and updated games to the database.

- **HRTF works again.** Since 0.29, games installed for headphones with HRTF played plain stereo, because OpenAL Soft never loaded its built-in HRTF. If you installed a game for headphones with 0.29.0, 0.29.1 or 0.29.2, run the script again and reinstall that game.
- **New games.** Titan Quest, Chrome, Chrome: SpecForce, Project I.G.I.-2 and Star Trek: Bridge Commander. Mafia: Definitive Edition is listed too. It has no EAX, so its entry points you to the original Mafia.
- **Updated games.** Call of Juarez is now marked as an OpenAL game. The Wheel of Time's EAX setting also turns on DirectSound. SWAT 4's note names the OpenAL Soft build that fixes the radio chatter. Medal of Honor: Allied Assault notes that the GOG release ships only Miles' software sound provider. Dungeons & Dragons: Dragonshard is now tested.
